description: CLAIMS_JSON is passed to python3 as a bash positional argument (gig_reality_verify.sh:31, re-consumed at line 77-85) rather than via stdin or a temp file. With N claim rows containing verbose Japanese titles/descriptions, a larger N (the script accepts an override: 'Usage: bash gig_reality_verify.sh [N_recent_rows]') could in principle approach OS ARG_MAX. Not hit at the default N=5 and not currently tested; behavioral-spec.md does not enumerate a max-claims-size edge case.
